results.title: Tokenizer drift in mixed-script corpora
results.snippet: Observed spikes around emoji clusters 👩🏽‍💻, path fragments, escaped JSON payloads, and short prompts padded with symbols.

results.title: Practical notes on GPT-style token accounting
results.snippet: Whitespace, punctuation grouping, and newline style can swing counts by 5-12% on short inputs and much more on mixed snippets.

results.title: Unicode surprises: ZWJ, combining marks, and boxes
results.snippet: Flags 🇧🇬 and decomposed characters like e\u0301 behave differently from plain ASCII; box-drawing text also shifts chunking.

results.title: Separator collapse in logs and command output
results.snippet: Repeated delimiters like ::, //, and retry_retry_retry become noisy when pasted from terminals, chats, and web dashboards.

results.title: Why neat benchmark prompts miss production mess
results.snippet: Real traffic blends tables, file paths, Markdown, multiple languages, and emotional punctuation in the same request.
